title: Provider-neutral bounded UI session bridge and safe resume

binding.lease: one exact lease identifier, worker identifier, and lease digest; resume cannot cross the binding

events.projection: Only bounded event identifiers, enumerations, sequence numbers, and evidence digests; no UI text, provider data, prompts, transcripts, credentials, or network values.
events.rule: Events are ordered, single-use, and followed by exactly one validated final event.

resume.safe_exit: A user-requested or host-shutdown safe exit is resumable only from a referenced UI checkpoint.
resume.interruption: An acknowledged interruption is resumable only from a referenced UI checkpoint.
resume.binding: Resume uses the exact task, project, worktree, session, and lease binding and the exact prior trace digest.
resume.completed: A completed session has no resume record.

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no UI, provider, network, process, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or durable-state operation.

privacy.projection: Opaque identifiers, bounded enumerations, positive sequences, and SHA-256 digests only.

limitations: A passing record proves only deterministic structural consistency of supplied UI observations.
The checker does not render UI, accept human input, acquire or renew a lease, persist a checkpoint, contact a provider or network, or prove Coordinator state.
UI and Coordinator remain authoritative for human intent and task/lease state respectively; a final event is not task completion or approval.
